title: How AI Agents Make Discord Support Faster with SeaTicket
excerpt: Open source teams, and gaming developers have a hard time to manage discord discussions, with no one channel to resolve the issues.
content_html:
Open source teams, and gaming developers have a hard time to manage discord discussions, with no one channel to resolve the issues.

How can they do it:

1. Create a Forum channel, connect SeaTicket, and for each post it will sync automatically, letting you see in one view the whole conversation.

2. For each reply AI agent will run, and research the issue from your documentation and connected sources like GitHub, email and forums.

3. It will write up a response that you can approve directly, and it will posted directly.

It is free to use, and you can try on your Discord server and let us know the results .
